supported_scope: Task-level token usage and quota visibility with detailed category breakdowns and model quota limits
unestablished_scope: Estimation methods for usage or cost
required_setup: No special setup required; usage and token breakdowns are available via built-in /context and /usage commands
constraints: Token usage is broken down by categories such as User messages, Agent responses, Tool calls, System prompt, and customizations
Model quotas and remaining requests/tokens are shown per supported model
Context window token usage includes checkpoint summaries and tracked files
Usage data is refreshed automatically when opening usage panels

evidence.section: Context command (/context) > Understand the context breakdown > Token usage categories
evidence.quote: The summary panel breaks down your token consumption into the following rows. The User messages, Agent responses, and Tool calls rows are always shown; the remaining rows appear only when that category is consuming tokens.
evidence.claim: The CLI provides detailed token usage breakdown by category in the /context panel.

evidence.quote: The /context command opens the interactive Context Usage panel in the Antigravity CLI. It displays a proportional visual grid of your model’s total context window alongside a category-by-category token breakdown, compaction checkpoints, and tracked workspace files.
evidence.claim: The /context command provides an interactive panel showing token usage and context window details.

evidence.section: Model quotas (/usage) > Viewing your usage > Interactive panel features
evidence.quote: The panel displays the following details: Model quotas: A breakdown of your usage limits and remaining requests/tokens for each supported model (such as Gemini 3.5 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro).
evidence.claim: The /usage command shows model quota usage and remaining tokens/requests.

evidence.quote: Antigravity CLI provides the /usage command (alias /quota) to help you monitor your resource consumption. When run, the command refreshes your model configuration and quota status from the backend and opens an interactive TUI panel.
evidence.claim: The CLI supports interactive usage monitoring with automatic refresh from backend.
